title: Scum's Wish
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schoolers Hanabi and Mugi each love a teacher who is falling for someone else, so they start a pretend relationship and use each other physically as substitutes. Around them, music teacher Akane seduces men for the thrill of winning, and Hanabi's friend Sanae, who loves her, enters a physical relationship with her. Yen Press publishes it in English; a reviewer called it deeply psychological and sometimes disturbing; rating to verify.
life_message: It shows using others to fill loneliness as hollow, and points toward honest self-knowledge.

delivery.evidence: Psychological drama shown through the teens' relationships; a reviewer called it deeply psychological (entry); no source comments on delivery (to verify)
delivery.note: The hollowness of using others is shown through the characters' choices rather than spelled out.

winners_losers: Akane gets the marriage she toys with, while Hanabi, Mugi and Sanae lose their first loves but gain self-understanding. Sympathy goes to the hurting teens, not to manipulators.
